name: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana
description: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana is a state-level welfare scheme of the Government of Haryana, implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to individuals aged 18-70 who have suffered accidental death or disability and are not registered under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY). The scheme is applicable only to permanent residents of Haryana who are currently residing in Haryana.
aliases: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana
benefits: ₹1,00,000 for total and permanent loss of both eyes.
₹1,00,000 for loss of both hands or both feet.
₹1,00,000 for loss of one eye and one hand or one foot.

rules.description: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Applicant must currently be residing in Haryana.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must be at most 70 years old.
The applicant or the person on whose behalf the claim is made must have suffered an accident resulting in death or disability.

In disability cases, the claimant must be the disabled person themselves. In death cases, eligible claimants are the spouse if not remarried, all unmarried children with equal share, mother, or father. No other claimant is eligible.

exclusion_rules.description: Applicant should not be registered under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY).

documents.description: Aadhaar Card of the applicant or claimant.
Document proving permanent residency and current residence in Haryana.
Copy of the FIR filed for the accident.
Medical report or disability certificate, applicable for disability cases.
Death certificate, applicable for death cases.
Postmortem report, applicable for death cases.

tutorial_steps.title: Visit Antyodaya-SARAL Portal
tutorial_steps.description: Visit the Antyodaya-SARAL Portal at https://saralharyana.gov.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: Register as new user
tutorial_steps.description: Click on 'New User/Register Here' to create a new account.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter registration details
tutorial_steps.description: Enter mandatory registration details including Name, Email ID, Mobile Number and password.

tutorial_steps.title: Verify OTP
tutorial_steps.description: Verify the OTP received through email or mobile, or use the verification link.

tutorial_steps.title: Login to the portal
tutorial_steps.description: Login to the Antyodaya-SARAL Portal using your credentials.

tutorial_steps.title: Select the scheme
tutorial_steps.description: Select Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana and click 'Apply for Service/Scheme'.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill application details
tutorial_steps.description: Fill in all required application details.

tutorial_steps.title: Track application
tutorial_steps.description: Track application or appeal status at https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: SMS tracking
tutorial_steps.description: For registered mobile number: send SARAL to 9954699899. For other mobile number: send SARAL <Application ID/Ticket No.> to 9954699899.
